title: Voltpilot MQTT Zero-Touch Provisioning Handshake
description: Zero-touch device onboarding. A factory-fresh edge device knows ONLY its edge reference (ref) and the broker host. It publishes a `hello` on provision/{ref}/hello and subscribes to provision/{ref}/config. Once the ref is claimed in the portal, the cloud publishes the device's identity RETAINED on the config topic; the device adopts it and switches to the normal frozen telemetry topics (mqtt-telemetry.schema.json). This file is a BINDING contract like the other files in this directory; it is ADDITIVE - the frozen telemetry/schedule contracts are unchanged.

x-topics.hello: provision/{ref}/hello  (Device -> Cloud, QoS1, not retained; re-published on a retry interval until config arrives)
x-topics.config: provision/{ref}/config  (Cloud -> Device, QoS1, RETAINED; published by the resolver on hello for a claimed ref AND by the portal api at claim time)

x-semantics.unclaimed-ref: A hello for a ref no tenant has claimed gets NO answer. The device keeps retrying hello; this is normal pre-onboarding state, not an error.
x-semantics.claim-later: A device may boot before it is claimed. It waits subscribed to provision/{ref}/config; the portal api publishes the retained config the moment the claim succeeds, so the config arrives without another hello.
x-semantics.re-provision: The config is retained, so a device that restarts (or reconnects) receives its identity again immediately on subscribe - no cloud round-trip needed.
x-semantics.identity: The ref in the config payload MUST equal the {ref} topic segment; devices MUST ignore a config whose ref does not match their own.

ref.description: The device's edge reference (device.external_ref): what the customer types when claiming. MQTT-topic-safe by construction (no '/', '+', '#').
